WITH v AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) nv,
         COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) nj
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT
  count(*) versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) members,
  sum(CASE WHEN rn=1 AND join_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_join,
  sum(CASE WHEN rn=1 AND valid_from <> join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) first_vf_ne_join,
  sum(CASE WHEN rn=1 AND nj>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi_join_dates,
  sum(CASE WHEN rn=1 AND join_date >= DATE '2025-04-28' AND join_date <= DATE '2026-05-03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fy2526,
  sum(CASE WHEN rn=1 AND join_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND join_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cal2025,
  count(DISTINCT member_key) keys,
  min(join_date), max(join_date),
  sum(CASE WHEN rn=1 AND home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan_store
FROM v

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn
  FROM dim_member),
cs AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, region, close_date, open_date FROM dim_store WHERE is_current)
SELECT fv.home_store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, cs.open_date, cs.close_date,
  sum(CASE WHEN join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fy2526,
  sum(CASE WHEN join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cal2025
FROM fv LEFT JOIN cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id
WHERE rn = 1 AND (join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2026-05-03')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from, valid_to,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id, valid_from) dup_vf
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fv WHERE dup_vf>1) dup_version_starts,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fv WHERE rn=1 AND home_store_id=129 AND join_date > DATE '2026-01-25') sav_after_close,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fv WHERE rn=1 AND home_store_id=129 AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-26' AND DATE '2026-05-03') sav_after_close_fy,
  (SELECT max(join_date) FROM fv WHERE rn=1 AND home_store_id=129) sav_last_join,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fv WHERE rn=1 AND home_store_id IN (136,137) AND join_date < CASE home_store_id WHEN 136 THEN DATE '2024-09-02' ELSE DATE '2024-11-04' END) before_open,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fv WHERE rn=1 AND home_store_id=999) s999,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates) stg_rows,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fv WHERE rn=1 AND home_store_id=119 AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-08' AND DATE '2025-10-12') pori_refit_joins

calls.statement:
WITH first_version AS (
    SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS version_no
    FROM dim_member
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, fv.home_store_id AS store_id, cs.store_name, COUNT(*) AS new_members
FROM first_version fv
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date
LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE fv.version_no = 1 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 2
